R14.arithmetic: Pieces are 3 1/2" wide (1x4, materials[0]) with 45 degree mitres on both ends (steps[2]), so long edge - short edge = 2 x 3 1/2 = 7. Plan pairs: 17 1/2 - 10 1/2 = 7 (steps[3]); 20 1/2 - 13 1/2 = 7 (steps[4]); 14 1/2 - 7 1/2 = 7 (steps[3], 8x10); but 17 1/2 - 9 1/2 = 8 (steps[4], 8x10). With the 1/4" groove each side, 9 1/2 + 1/2 = 10 matches the 8x10 photo, so the 17 1/2 long edge is the inconsistent number (9 1/2 + 7 = 16 1/2).
R14.reason: Adjudicated: (a) the 8x10 long-side numbers in steps[4] do not add up; cannot be cut as a 45/45 mitre on 3 1/2" stock. The main 11x14 build matches the Kreg-corrected cut list.
